BiblicalUsage: An assemblage is the congregation and the council: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob, and Nehemiah consulted with himself, and rebuked the nobles, and said, ye exact usury, every one of his brother.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the assembly as the people who inherit the law and the council that must be rebuked when it forgets it.
